status: Frozen docs-only metadata-feasibility proposal; not execution authorization receipt or selected model split
list_hash_encoding: UTF-8 newline-delimited event IDs with one trailing newline; selected-set hash sorts IDs lexicographically, query-order hash preserves specified hash rank. IDs are not published or written here.

missingness_gate.minimum_known_NZ_P_coverage_each_stratum: ceil(0.5*n); all 15 strata retain frozen n, including failed/unknown/unattempted
missingness_gate.resolved_gate_definition: Identity-matched unique preferred origin with valid timezone-aware origin UTC time in [2003-08-01,2025-01-01); latitude/longitude/depth completeness is not a prerequisite. Preserve reviewed parser status and separately count unique linkage, time validity/window and complete geometry.

scope: New preferred-origin-associated P-pick metadata only; origin time/latlon/depth retained offline for sequence audits, not model inputs. No StationXML, miniSEED, model, fit, cloud resource, origin-derived theoretical arrivals or new CMT labels in this phase.

sampling_interpretation.method: Fixed reproducible SHA256-ranked pseudorandom stratification, with selection independent of pick/response/model outcomes
sampling_interpretation.design_probability: n/N under exchangeable random-hash ranking; no new stochastic draw or empirical unbiasedness guarantee
sampling_interpretation.frame_weight: N/n; failures keep weights and frozen denominators
weight_limitations: Does not correct availability-dependent or response-dependent missingness
Does not correct CMT selection or station-record selection
Later bulk claims apply to a prespecified evaluable CMT population, not all NZ earthquakes

origin_audit.origin_time: One timezone-aware time value, normalized to UTC; absent/invalid/naive/duplicate reasons retained without imputation
origin_audit.latitude: One finite value within [-90,90]; missing/invalid/duplicate reasons retained
origin_audit.longitude: One finite value within [-180,180]; missing/invalid/duplicate reasons retained
origin_audit.depth_meters: One finite value, negative allowed and descriptively flagged; source unit/reference provenance retained
origin_audit.cardinality: Zero/multiple preferredOriginID elements or zero/multiple matching origins are missing/ambiguous linkage. Duplicated time/latitude/longitude/depth containers or values are ambiguous; do not choose first. Geometry failures do not erase separately valid associated P coverage.
origin_audit.CMT_origin_signed_delta_seconds: originUTC minus pinned literal CMT minute-start UTC; not true inferred origin seconds
origin_audit.earliest_NZ_P_origin_signed_delta_second: earliest accepted associated NZ P minus originUTC
earliest_NZ_P_origin_flags: earliest NZ pick outside source window
origin_audit.anomaly_policy: Descriptive only; cannot reject, reassign, refetch, impute or become magnitude-model inputs. Preserve exact event-ID/parser failure rules; no theoretical-arrival fallback.
